arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. The first 10 entries in the failed_jobs table show issues. The production pgbouncer connection pool is exhausted, causing worker throughput to drop to 0. Restarting pgbouncer in prod clears the connection pool immediately.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Restart pgbouncer in the prod namespace to clear the connection pool and resume normal operations. Investigate the root cause of job failures and address them to prevent future issues.
